hook.name: LFWAHook
hook.description: A dedicated ETH/LFWA pool hook that charges a configurable fee (in basis points) on both buy and sell swaps. On buys (ETH→LFWA), the fee is deducted from the ETH input in beforeSwap via a return delta; on sells (LFWA→ETH), the fee is deducted from the ETH output in afterSwap. Fees are routed to an immutable feeRecipient via poolManager.take().
